snippet.title: Mox Nox Early Access Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Play Mox Nox on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5375770/Mox_Nox/

Sword combat, magic, and a fight against the alliance of good and evil hunting the last Reaper. Watch Early Access gameplay from Mox Nox, a dark fantasy action game in active development.

These bosses fight back with more than brute force. They react to how you fight, punish missed attacks, and change their approach when you repeat the same tricks. Get predictable, and they’ll make you pay.

How can you win? How can you claim what's rightfully yours?

Parry incoming strikes, dodge deadly attacks, and hit back with devastating counters. Unleash brutal combos, summon phantoms to fight beside you as well as other dark magic, and finish your enemies with bloody executions.

Mox Nox has released in Early Access. Free demo coming soon!
